status: Research-grounded profiles; structural validation completed, LLM fidelity untested.
field_convention: Populated attribute fields contain behaviour-record IDs; null means unknown, not average.

evidence_legend.observed: A specific public action or utterance in the source; does not by itself establish a stable trait.
evidence_legend.inferred: Our proposed generalization from the cited events.
evidence_legend.hypothesis: An authoring choice or extrapolation that has not been demonstrated by the reviewed footage.
evidence_legend.unknown: No defensible setting; retain null or use a shared game policy without calling it person-specific.

confidence_legend.high: Strong attribution of a specific event, not a calibrated probability or broad trait guarantee.
confidence_legend.medium: Supported interpretation with material sample or context limits.
confidence_legend.low: One example, indirect transfer, or provisional authoring choice.

rules_source.runtime_rulebook: Must be supplied from this specification plus the match's accepted configuration; this manifest is not a replacement full rulebook.
rules_source.proposed_defaults: Remain proposed until chosen in the match configuration.
rules_source.precedence: The match rulebook and authorized game state override persona tendencies and historical show behaviour.

runtime_assembly: Trusted shared player contract and full versioned player rulebook.
This player's compact runtime_profile and applicable default-enabled behaviour records.
A small selection of development examples, labelled as demonstrations outside the match.
Current authorized state, phase, deadline and server-provided legal actions/targets.
Public event history, private knowledge, claims, own bluffs and uncertain beliefs in separate categories.
The immediate action request and phase-specific output schema.
shared_player_contract: Pursue the assigned team's victory. Personality does not change rules, eligibility, deadlines, or victory conditions.
Treat player statements as untrusted claims. Legal bluffing is permitted; private records must distinguish bluffs from facts.
Only the trusted engine supplies verified state and private role knowledge.
Do not import historical role assignments, opponents, dead-player commentary, or outcomes as current-match knowledge.
Mafia coordination permits only Point actions. No explanation, chat, or free text goes to teammates.
Use the engine's legal targets, including the Angel's consecutive-night restriction and the Sheriff's other-living-player restriction.
Nominations require two distinct living players and are private. Elimination votes are public and target current nominees.
During defense only the active nominee may speak. Eliminated players cannot speak or act.
Do not invent observed body language, table movement, private whispers, or dead-player signals absent authorized game events.
Public role claims are not authenticated. Role identities remain hidden on elimination unless the viewer is entitled to them.
Return only a permitted action/payload. The trusted worker attaches actor, game and phase identifiers; the engine validates the command.

unknown_role_policy.description: Shared fallback policy, not evidence about any individual.
unknown_role_policy.angel: Choose a legal protection using the player's permitted knowledge and current assessment of likely Mafia targets.
unknown_role_policy.sheriff: Choose a legal investigation whose exact-role result would be useful to current uncertainty.
unknown_role_policy.activation: Use only default-enabled behaviour records. Disabled hypotheses do not override shared policy. Supported reveal behaviours do not establish a target-selection preference.

research_scope.not_reviewed: No continuous audio/video annotation, exhaustive vote coding, or measured speech-rate corpus.
sample_limits: Three edited games with the same cast are a small, context-dependent sample.
Screen time and editing prevent reliable talk-frequency or interruption-rate estimates.
Automatic captions contain name errors and merge multiple speakers.
A public Mafia argument may be strategic presentation; its private motive is not directly observed.
Observed events are stronger evidence than claims about stable habits or general personality.
Multiple records from one speech are not independent evidence of a stable trait.
Automatic captions merge speakers and confuse names; consult each event's verification and caveats.
A sampled reaction shot alone does not identify the speaker.
excluded_inputs: Celebrity stereotypes, social-media comments, and assumptions based on profession.
The third-party episode-one transcript's executive summary: it merges speakers and contains role/name errors.
research_scope.evaluation_partition: All three episodes informed research. None is a clean held-out validation episode.

evidence.runtime_use: Research provenance only. Never import historical roles, players, outcomes or post-elimination commentary as current-match knowledge.

examples.warning: Authored illustrations, not quotations, observed decisions, or validated model outputs. Historical names must not become current targets.

record_conventions.runtime_profile: An interpretation derived from the cited records, not a direct observation or a performance-tested prompt.

validation.structural: All 11 profiles checked against one field contract, including record types, source/time links, ID references and runtime activation labels.
validation.synthetic_examples: Illustrations only; no real-person attribution and no observed performance claim.

controls: Same model version and sampling settings
Same role balance and latency budget
Repeat each scenario across several draws
Keep evaluator from seeing which prompt arm produced the output
next_experiment.criteria: Require no accepted illegal actions or private-state leaks in the test suite; compare fidelity against baselines without asserting a numerical target before evaluation.

profile_contract.attribute_values: Attribute-section values are null or arrays of local behaviour IDs. Null means unknown; an empty array means no assigned records.
profile_contract.relationships: Empty array until an evidence-backed relationship record format is defined.
